text: How do you keep a card number so that even a stolen database is useless?
prefix: How do you keep a card number so that even a stolen database is useless?

text: In Lesson 5, the card went straight into the card zone, and only a token came back.
prefix: In Lesson 5, the card went straight into the card zone, and only a token came back.

text: In Lesson 6, Vault held every key, and no key was ever typed into a file.
prefix: In Lesson 6, Vault held every key, and no key was ever typed into a file.

text: This lesson uses Vault to seal each card number, so even a stolen database is useless.
prefix: This lesson uses Vault to seal each card number, so even a stolen database is useless.

text: Picture the worst day.
prefix: Picture the worst day.

text: A copy of the database leaks.
prefix: A copy of the database leaks.

text: If the card table holds numbers, every card is gone.
prefix: If the card table holds numbers, every card is gone.

text: If it holds numbers locked with a key that sits next to them, every card is still gone.
prefix: If it holds numbers locked with a key that sits next to them, every card is still gone.

text: So the key must never sit next to the data.
prefix: So the key must never sit next to the data.

text: Remember the locked room from earlier lessons.
prefix: Remember the locked room from earlier lessons.

text: Inside it, every coat goes into a sealed bag.
prefix: Inside it, every coat goes into a sealed bag.

text: Only one machine can seal a bag or open it.
prefix: Only one machine can seal a bag or open it.

text: That machine never lends out its key.
prefix: That machine never lends out its key.

text: In the card zone, that machine is Vault.
prefix: In the card zone, that machine is Vault.

text: The card vault, the service that keeps cards, hands Vault the card number.
prefix: The card vault, the service that keeps cards, hands Vault the card number.

text: Vault hands back a sealed value.
prefix: Vault hands back a sealed value.

text: The card vault keeps only the sealed value.
prefix: The card vault keeps only the sealed value.

text: The key never leaves Vault.
prefix: The key never leaves Vault.

text: Each seal is tied to its own card.
prefix: Each seal is tied to its own card.

text: A sealed value copied into another card's place will not open.
prefix: A sealed value copied into another card's place will not open.

text: So nobody can shuffle bags to trick the room.
prefix: So nobody can shuffle bags to trick the room.

text: Now a puzzle.
prefix: Now a puzzle.

text: Sometimes the card zone must find a card again by its number.
prefix: Sometimes the card zone must find a card again by its number.

text: It must do that without opening every bag.
prefix: It must do that without opening every bag.

text: So Vault also stamps each bag with a fingerprint.
prefix: So Vault also stamps each bag with a fingerprint.

text: The same number always gives the same fingerprint.
prefix: The same number always gives the same fingerprint.

text: The fingerprint cannot be turned back into the number.
prefix: The fingerprint cannot be turned back into the number.

text: This stamp is called a blind index.
prefix: This stamp is called a blind index.

text: The card zone looks up the fingerprint, never the number.
prefix: The card zone looks up the fingerprint, never the number.

text: The database guards the door too.
prefix: The database guards the door too.

text: It refuses any card value that is not sealed.
prefix: It refuses any card value that is not sealed.

text: Even a mistake in the code cannot write a plain number into it.
prefix: Even a mistake in the code cannot write a plain number into it.

text: What if Vault is down?
prefix: What if Vault is down?

text: Then the card vault stops.
prefix: Then the card vault stops.

text: It never guesses, and it never falls back to keeping a plain number.
prefix: It never guesses, and it never falls back to keeping a plain number.

text: Stopping safely instead of carrying on unsafely is called fail closed.
prefix: Stopping safely instead of carrying on unsafely is called fail closed.

text: A number is opened for one reason only: to hand it to the card's network for a charge.
prefix: A number is opened for one reason only: to hand it to the card's network for a charge.

text: Every use of card data is written down: what happened, who asked, and when.
prefix: Every use of card data is written down: what happened, who asked, and when.

text: And a card nobody has used for the bank's chosen time is removed.
prefix: And a card nobody has used for the bank's chosen time is removed.

text: Only a short note keeps its token and its masked number.
prefix: Only a short note keeps its token and its masked number.

text: Now watch the product.
prefix: Now watch the product.

text: There is no screen inside the locked room, so watch what each side sees.
prefix: There is no screen inside the locked room, so watch what each side sees.

text: The buyer types a card into the card form and confirms the code.
prefix: The buyer types a card into the card form and confirms the code.

text: The form says "Card accepted" and empties its number field.
prefix: The form says "Card accepted" and empties its number field.

text: The payment page then shows one line: the first six digits, a row of stars, and the last four.
prefix: The payment page then shows one line: the first six digits, a row of stars, and the last four.

text: Beside them sit the card's network and the bank that issued it.
prefix: Beside them sit the card's network and the bank that issued it.

text: That masked line is all anyone outside the room ever sees.
prefix: That masked line is all anyone outside the room ever sees.

text: Now Vault stops answering.
prefix: Now Vault stops answering.

text: The buyer types a card, and the form refuses it with a short message.
prefix: The buyer types a card, and the form refuses it with a short message.

text: Nothing is saved, sealed or unsealed.
prefix: Nothing is saved, sealed or unsealed.

text: On the bank's side, the team gets an alert: a service the card zone depends on is unavailable.
prefix: On the bank's side, the team gets an alert: a service the card zone depends on is unavailable.

text: The alert names the part that failed.
prefix: The alert names the part that failed.

text: Once Vault is back, the same card goes through.
prefix: Once Vault is back, the same card goes through.

text: Now the leaked copy again.
prefix: Now the leaked copy again.

text: An attacker opens it.
prefix: An attacker opens it.

text: They find sealed values, fingerprints and masked numbers.
prefix: They find sealed values, fingerprints and masked numbers.

text: The keys are not there.
prefix: The keys are not there.

text: A backup is just as useless without the Vault that sealed it, so the bank keeps both, and keeps them apart.
prefix: A backup is just as useless without the Vault that sealed it, so the bank keeps both, and keeps them apart.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: It protects every cardholder whose number has ever passed through the room.
prefix: It protects every cardholder whose number has ever passed through the room.

text: A stolen database, a stolen backup, or a curious insider all see noise.
prefix: A stolen database, a stolen backup, or a curious insider all see noise.

text: And the bank is protected too, because a leak of noise is not a leak of cards.
prefix: And the bank is protected too, because a leak of noise is not a leak of cards.

text: Back to the sealed bags.
prefix: Back to the sealed bags.

text: A machine that keeps its key.
prefix: A machine that keeps its key.

text: A stamp that finds a bag without opening it.
prefix: A stamp that finds a bag without opening it.

text: A database that refuses anything unsealed.
prefix: A database that refuses anything unsealed.

text: So a stolen copy of the database is just noise.
